scope: Strict-R3 live execution auditability repair: persist a self-contained immutable entry/exit microstructure and PnL record at confirmed full close. Operational telemetry only; no score, admission, sizing, or policy-decision semantics changed.

contract.write_time: before close-email delivery, after confirmed full-close payload construction
contract.identity: candidate_id + entry fill time + entry fill price
contract.immutability: telemetry payload is stored with a canonical SHA-256 at reservation; later status updates change notification state only
entry_evidence: actual entry fill price, amount and notional
spread, expected VWAP, impact and delay metrics
full entry ticker/order-book snapshot and protective-stop book
exit_evidence: actual exit fill price, amount and notional
policy/protective thresholds, execution method and fill-quality gaps
full exit ticker/order-book snapshot and detection book
VWAP/impact, replay comparison, stop path, PnL and fee verification
contract.scope_limit: A Kraken-native stop's internal trigger-time book remains unavailable; the record preserves its immediate public post-close snapshot and marks the provenance.

validation.additional: python3 -m py_compile extreme_price_movements/inference/strict_r3_live_execution.py passed; ruff is not installed in the local runtime.

deployment_note: The running v146 services retain their loaded code. This source-only repair requires the normal sealed execution-contract successor and a fresh-minute monitor restart before it can collect new live telemetry.
